annotations.title: List items a supplier could carry

description: Catalogue items this supplier does NOT carry yet but could — the picker behind "add items to supplier". Feed what you choose to link_supplier_items. Only stock-managed items appear: something the merchant does not track stock for cannot be purchase-ordered at all, so if an expected item is missing here and missing from get_supplier_items too, the reason is almost always that stock tracking is off for it — say that instead of guessing. Omit supplierId to search the whole linkable catalogue, e.g. while deciding which supplier to create. Returns everything matching, unpaged, so pass a search.

search.description: Match product name, item name, SKU or barcode

supplierId.description: Supplier id — omit to see the whole linkable catalogue
